status: Conditional pulse-response reference; aggregate improvement with regime counterexamples

findings.statement: Reference MAE is0.356202V versus0.622043V for the strongest fixed comparator, a42.74percent aggregate reduction. Against constant gain, only zero-distance110kHz improves; all five other conditions worsen. Its contact110 error is1.478V, contact500 error0.656V; air errors are0.000215–0.001453V. The amplitude range makes aggregate gain contact-dominated. Treat this as a conditional instrument-response reference, not an air-propagation or universally useful pulse law.
findings.scope: Six condition files at one reserved5us width, not six independent reserved width experiments. Gain is concentrated in zero-distance110kHz contact; air and500kHz sensor counterexamples remain.

findings.statement: Group counterexamples, stronger-comparator outcomes and source ambiguities constrain mechanistic and industrial transfer claims; no equations are promoted solely because generated by a stronger model.

scientific_review: Computational checks by same operator in a separate phase; no independent agent, human expert or experimental replication.
